notes: Pure-Python Atheris harness. The Mayhem target is a thin ELF launcher (mayhem/launcher.c) that execs python3 on the harness, because Mayhem requires an ELF target. One target: fuzz-parse (the original mayhemheroes harness mayhem/fuzz_parse_report.py, driving parsedmarc.parse_report_file offline). The original harness passed parallel=True to parse_report_file; that keyword no longer exists in upstream, so it was dropped (API-drift fix). The behavioral oracle (mayhem/parsedmarc_oracle) is likewise an ELF launcher so the anti-reward-hack sabotage check can neuter it; it parses the RFC 9990 aggregate sample and asserts decoded values.
